behaviors_asserted: Using hono/timing can raise TypeError: Can't modify immutable headers.
Common workaround is to wrap timing and replace c.res with a new Response(c.res.body, c.res) to ensure the response is mutable.
The timing middleware is often used as a bookend for the entire middleware chain, making this a common pitfall.
The timing middleware should itself ensure the response is mutable (so callers don't need to wrap it).
